findings.description: Response.__init__ now reads self.raw.reason, but self.raw is None on a freshly created Response(). In requests, raw is initialized to None in __init__ and only set later by the adapter. The unconditional attribute access raises AttributeError.
findings.rationale: Trigger: calling Response() directly, as many tests and mocks do, or any code path that builds a Response before setting raw. Mechanism: self.raw.reason dereferences None. Impact: AttributeError at construction. Even when raw is set, adapters previously assigned reason explicitly (e.g. build_response sets response.reason = response.raw.reason), and raw.reason may itself be None, so the str constraint is not enforced either.
